node.label: Periarticular soft-tissue mass
node.definition: A lump detected in the region that surrounds a joint. In this context, mass is a general term for a lump or growth that may be caused by the abnormal growth of cells, a cyst, hormonal changes, or an immune reaction.

evidence.snippet: Mucopolysaccharidosis type IX: Periarticular soft-tissue mass (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
